release_notes: MBT POS v3.0.89: Rolling cloud backups and new MugoByte Cloud endpoint. Existing retired-project configs migrate automatically, legacy sub-hour schedules move to 24 hours, backups overwrite latest.mbtenc plus keep seven daily slots, and old timestamp dumps are pruned. Includes v3.0.88 Remote Ops Phase 1 and preserves license/device identity during upgrade.
